# 金山词霸 (Kingsoft iCIBA)

> > AI-powered multilingual translation and dictionary platform supporting 177 languages with text, image, and document translation capabilities.

金山词霸 (Kingsoft iCIBA) is a comprehensive Chinese-English dictionary and translation service featuring content from authoritative sources like Collins and Oxford dictionaries. The platform offers vocabulary learning tools for standardized tests including CET-4/6, TOEFL, IELTS, GRE, GMAT, and business English certifications.

## Key Topics

- 金山词霸 (Kingsoft)
- 爱词霸 (iCIBA)
- AI Translation
- Chinese-English Dictionary
- Collins Dictionary (柯林斯词典)
- Oxford Dictionary (牛津词典)
- Multilingual Translation (177 languages)
- Document & Image Translation
- CET-4/6 (大学英语四六级)
- TOEFL & IELTS Preparation
- GRE, GMAT, SAT Test Prep
- BEC Business English
- Vocabulary Learning
- Online Dictionary Tools
- Translation Examples & Usage

## Core Translation Services

- [金山词霸 Homepage](https://www.iciba.com): Main portal for Kingsoft AI translation supporting 177 languages with text, image, and document translation
- [Translation Tool](https://translate.iciba.com): Dedicated AI-powered multilingual translation service subdomain

## Dictionary & Word Reference

- [Word Dictionary Entry (HTTPS)](https://www.iciba.com/word): Comprehensive dictionary page with translations, phonetics, pronunciation, usage examples, and definitions
- [Word Dictionary Entry (HTTP)](http://www.iciba.com/word): Dictionary entry page with translations, examples, and bilingual reference materials

## Vocabulary Learning & Test Preparation

- [爱词吧 Vocabulary Learning Platform](https://word.iciba.com): Online vocabulary memorization tool for CET-4/6, TOEFL, IELTS, GRE, GMAT, SAT, and BEC test preparation
